questions.question: Which country has become the first in the world to receive the World Health Organization (WHO) verification for eliminating leprosy, a significant public health milestone?
The Nepal Himalayas is demarcated by the ________ and Teesta rivers.
In 1927, the British Government in England decided to send a Commission under the chairmanship of _________ to decide the political future of India.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Sir John Simon) है।

questions.question: _____ contrasting characters were carried out by Mendel in garden pea.
Ranjit Sagar Dam is located in which of the following states?
Who became the first Indian woman to record two consecutive ODI hundreds during the second ODI against South Africa at the M Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru in June 2024?
The imposition of restrictions on imports by the government in the form of taxes is called _______.
As of March 2025, who is the Union Minister of External Affairs for India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Dr. Subrahmanyam Jaishankar) है।

questions.question: When was the Verma Committee on Fundamental Duties of Citizens set up by the Indian Government to look into the practical aspects of Fundamental Duties and suggest actions that can inform and educate people about the need of abiding by them?
Which hybridisation of carbon is more acidic?
Which of the following authors describes the life of a little boy in the quaint Indian town of Malgudi?
As per Article 317 of the Indian Constitution, the Chairman or any other member of the State Public Service Commission (SPSC) can be removed by the ________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (President of India) है।

questions.question: Which Union Territory was established in 2019 without a legislature?
Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about hypersonic missile trial in India?
options: This hypersonic missile is designed to carry various payloads for ranges greater than 1500 km for the Armed Forces.
This missile has been indigenously developed by the laboratories of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Missile complex, Hyderabad, along with various other DRDO laboratories and Industry Partners.
Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) conducted a successful flight-trial of India’s first long-range hypersonic missile in November 2024.
This breakthrough puts India among an elite group of nations like the US, Russia and China.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) conducted a successful flight-trial of India’s first long-range hypersonic missile in November 2024.) है।

questions.question: The part of the shadow where all the light coming from the source is blocked by the object being shadowed is called:
When did brothers Sidhu and Kanhu Murmu start the Santhal Rebellion, a major armed rebellion against the British East India Company and the Zamindari system?
Which of the following rivers flows in Rajasthan and Gujarat?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Luni and Sabarmati) है।

questions.question: The Khajuraho Monuments were built in the 10th and 11th centuries in the Nagara Style by the _______ dynasty.
Which of the following acids is often added to canned food and beverages to keep them fresh for a longer period?
Which of the following has been merged into the Receipts Budget from 2016-17 onwards in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Statement of Revenue Foregone) है।
